detailed.headline: Possible change river-condition anomaly at Pra Upper Basin
detailed.explanation: On 2026-07-21 the satellite sediment indicator at Pra Upper Basin (P01) read +0.103. Given the season, recent rainfall and upstream conditions, +0.098 would have been expected — the reading is 0.9 standard deviations above that. Rainfall over the preceding 7 days totalled 6 mm, which is drier than normal for this time of year. This is the first observation showing the change. Observation quality is ACCEPTABLE; overall confidence is moderate. This indicates unusual surface-water conditions that may warrant investigation. It does not identify a cause, and it does not demonstrate mining activity or the presence of any specific contaminant.
detailed.recommended_action: No immediate action. Confirm on the next pass before treating this as a genuine change.
